name: FPP Arcade Multi-Player
author: Daniel Kulp
description: Various Games to Play on FPP Pixel Overlay Models.  Enables Multi-Player functionality for games that support it (Pong), and adds Pacman.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device. Reads a USB gamepad if you plug one in; nothing is stored. A controller button can be set to send its command to other FPP players you pick.

sends.to: the FPP players you pick in a controller mapping
sends.what: the FPP command you mapped to a controller button or axis
sends.why: to run that command on other players in your show

privacy.other: Reads any USB joystick or gamepad plugged into this device and keeps the last 20 button presses in memory (readable on its Joysticks page and at /api/plugin-apis/arcade/events by anyone who can open FPP's web pages; cleared when fppd restarts); nothing is written to disk. Its game and joystick settings (config/plugin.fpp-arcade.json and config/joysticks.json) are kept after uninstall.
